title: Formononetin attenuates LPS-induced neuroinflammation and depressive-like behaviors by regulating the Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 pathway in the hippocampus.
authors: Quan, Siqi; Li, Mengyuan; Yue, Zhouli; Liu, Hui; Peng, Shuaijun; Guo, Roujia; Fang, Xiaoyan; Li, Yucheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芒柄花素通过Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1通路缓解LPS诱导的神经炎症和抑郁样行为，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Neuroinflammation and oxidative stress are major pathogenic drivers of depression, with the Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 pathway serving as a key regulator of both processes. Formononetin (FMN) is a naturally occurring isoflavone with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities; however, its potential to exert antidepressant effects through activation of this pathway has not been investigated. In this study, lipopolysaccharide (LPS, 1 mg/kg, i.p.) was used to induce neuroinflammation and depressive-like behaviors in mice, and FMN (20 or 40 mg/kg) was administered for seven days prior to LPS challenge. FMN dose-dependently alleviated LPS-induced behavioral deficits, including reduced sucrose preference, decreased locomotor activity, and prolonged immobility in the tail suspension test. Hematoxylin-eosin (HE) and Nissl staining revealed that FMN markedly attenuated LPS-induced hippocampal neuronal damage. FMN also inhibited microglial activation, as evidenced by reduced Iba-1 expression, decreased NF-kappaB phosphorylation, and downregulation of both mRNA and protein levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and IL-6. Furthermore, LPS-induced lipid peroxidation was significantly attenuated, as indicated by lower levels of 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE). Molecular docking suggested a potential direct interaction between FMN and Keap1, while Western blot analysis confirmed that FMN downregulated Keap1 and upregulated Nrf2 and HO-1 protein expression. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that FMN alleviates LPS-induced neuroinflammation and depressive-like behaviors, likely through activating the Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 pathway, supporting its potential as a preventive candidate for inflammation-associated depression.
abstract_zh: 神经炎症和氧化应激是抑郁症的主要致病驱动因素，其中Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1通路作为这两个过程的关键调节因子。芒柄花素（FMN）是一种天然存在的异黄酮，具有抗炎和抗氧化活性；然而，其通过激活该通路发挥抗抑郁作用的潜力尚未被研究。在本研究中，使用脂多糖（LPS，1 mg/kg，腹腔注射）诱导小鼠神经炎症和抑郁样行为，并在LPS刺激前给予FMN（20或40 mg/kg）七天。FMN剂量依赖性地缓解了LPS诱导的行为缺陷，包括蔗糖偏好降低、运动活性下降以及悬尾试验中不动时间延长。苏木精-伊红（HE）和尼氏染色显示，FMN显著减轻了LPS诱导的海马神经元损伤。FMN还抑制了小胶质细胞活化，表现为Iba-1表达减少、NF-kappaB磷酸化降低，以及促炎细胞因子（包括IL-1beta、TNF-alpha和IL-6）的mRNA和蛋白水平下调。此外，LPS诱导的脂质过氧化显著减轻，表现为4-羟基壬烯醛（4-HNE）水平降低。分子对接提示FMN与Keap1之间可能存在直接相互作用，而Western blot分析证实FMN下调Keap1并上调Nrf2和HO-1蛋白表达。综合来看，这些发现表明FMN通过可能激活Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1通路缓解LPS诱导的神经炎症和抑郁样行为，支持其作为炎症相关抑郁症预防候选药物的潜力。
